record.reason: Primary abstract: Motivated by practical applications in the design of optimization compilers for neural networks, we initiated the study of identity testing problems for arithmetic circuits augmented with \emph{exponentiation gates} that compute the real function $x\mapsto e^x$.
record.title: Identity Testing for Circuits with Exponentiation Gates
